Minimal pass: reline L3 into sung couplet + refrain tag; no new doctrine. First L4 verse of this work: owner verdict requested before continuing (rules 15/17).

lines: He alone conquers — Śiva, throbbing, self-standing,
tasting the inward face — conquers alone.
